entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana. I... I need to return something. I just feel so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly help you. Could I get your name and order number to start?
Yes, it's Michael Chen. Order number 774-29B-11. It's for the ProFit jersey.
Thank you, Michael. I'm pulling up your order now. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

It's just the wrong size. I saved up for this, and it's just... too tight across the shoulders. I've been a VeloFit customer for years and this has never happened. I was thinking about an exchange, but with the holidays, I think I really just need the money back.
I completely understand, and I'm very sorry for the disappointment with the fit. Let me check the return policy for you. One moment.
Okay, thank you. I really hope you can help.
Alright Michael, I've got it here. I see the jersey was delivered 12 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window, so I can absolutely process a full refund for you. No problem at all.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Diana.

Of course. And I see here that you're one of our VIP members. We really value your loyalty. As a thank you, I've gone ahead and waived the return shipping fee and added a 15% discount to your account for your next purchase. I'm emailing you the pre-paid return label right now.
Wow, that's incredibly generous. You've really turned this around for me. I appreciate it.
It's my pleasure, Michael. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
